name: Yonder Connector
description: Registers this OpenClaw gateway with a Yonder account: its agents as Bots and its sessions through the cloud's existing work bridge (spec 23). Outbound only — no inbound port, no transcript copy, no device-execution methods.

endpoint.description: Yonder 服务地址（默认 https://yonderbot.net）

stateDir.description: 覆盖连接器状态目录（默认 <OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR>/yonder）

toolsOnly.description: 只提供状态工具，不建立后台连接
